item.text: {"items":[{"id":"g1","options":[{"text":"Leydig cell","verdict":"plausible","reason":"A fetal testicular cell commonly confused with Sertoli cells."},{"text":"Granulosa cell","verdict":"plausible","reason":"This ovarian cell also secretes anti-Müllerian hormone."},{"text":"Spermatogonium","verdict":"weak","reason":"A testicular cell, but not an endocrine support cell."},{"text":"None of the above","verdict":"throwaway","reason":"A hedge option."}]},{"id":"g2","options":[{"text":"Leuprolide","verdict":"plausible","reason":"A GnRH agonist used for prostate cancer; agonist and antagonist are a classic confusion."},{"text":"Flutamide","verdict":"plausible","reason":"An antiandrogen used in prostate cancer, but it does not block the GnRH receptor."},{"text":"Finasteride","verdict":"weak","reason":"A prostate-related hormonal drug, but it inhibits 5-alpha-reductase."},{"text":"Amoxicillin","verdict":"throwaway","reason":"An antibiotic with no relevant drug-class connection."}]},{"id":"g3","options":[{"text":"Isthmus of the uterine tube","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Another segment of the uterine tube."},{"text":"Uterine fundus","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Could be confused with the site of implantation."},{"text":"Infundibulum of the uterine tube","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Another segment of the uterine tube, near where the oocyte enters."},{"text":"Both the ampulla and the fundus","verdict":"throwaway","reason":"A both-of-the-above hedge."}]},{"id":"g4","options":[{"text":"21-hydroxylase","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Its deficiency also causes virilization, but typically not hypertension."},{"text":"17-alpha-hydroxylase","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Its deficiency causes hypertension, but not virilization of a 46,XX infant."},{"text":"Aromatase","verdict":"plausible","reason":"Its deficiency can virilize a 46,XX fetus, but does not cause this hypertension pattern."},{"text":"Left anterior descending artery","verdict":"throwaway","reason":"An artery, not an enzyme."}]}]}
